svg.title: SSE topology
svg.desc: Five SSE endpoints and what feeds them. The task stream and the agent-execution stream are served by task_sse_routes from the EventBus, RunnerObserver and TaskProgressTracker. The workflow stream filters the bus by run. The global stream is SseBroadcast, fed by EventBusSseBridge and by direct runtime emitters. The chat stream forwards one turn from its worker.

g.text: Hover a box for its role and file; its connections light up. Click it to open its section.
Inside a rendered document this image is static. Click it to open the interactive SVG.

svg.text: Five streams, each fed by its own route. The chat stream is transient; durable messages stay the recovery authority.

g.text: RunnerObserver · capacityChanges feeds execution_capacity frames; it is not an EventBus event
Fed by the ExecutionCoordinator stream alone. runner_state is separate: RunnerStateChangedEvent on the bus.
TaskProgressTracker · onProgress feeds task_progress frames, at most one per second per task
task/task_progress_tracker.dart; internals in the Task & Execution Architecture, section 7.
EventBus · each stream subscribes only to the event types it forwards
Subscriptions live as long as the connection: every stream cancels them in controller.onCancel.
runtime emitters · TurnGovernanceEnforcer, EmergencyStopHandler, TurnRunner, DeliveryService, conversation services broadcast directly
Frames: budget_warning, rate_limit_warning, emergency_stop, context_warning, turn_progress_stall, announce, conversation_changed.
TurnManager · a settled turn replays from recentOutcome; otherwise worker.events is forwarded until waitForOutcome returns
task_sse_routes.dart · the connected frame carries review count, active tasks, runners with capacity, projects and active workflows
Every frame has a type field. task_progress is throttled to one per second per task; task_event is not.
workflow_routes.dart · _workflowRunSseHandler: a connected frame with run and step state, then events filtered by runId
Also forwards the run's task_status_changed and workflow_cli_turn_progress per finished CLI turn; 404 for an unknown run.
EventBusSseBridge · forwards loop_detected, task_review_ready, compaction_starting and conversation_changed (with work_state)
Excludes EmergencyStopEvent: EmergencyStopHandler owns that frame, so a stop is never sent twice.
SseBroadcast · fans named events to all connected clients and drops closed ones
Exists only when the primary lane is enabled; /api/events answers 503 SSE_UNAVAILABLE otherwise.
stream_handler.dart · delta, tool_use and tool_result as HTML fragments, redacted and escaped
Terminal frames are turn_error or turn_cancelled, then done. It opens with an SSE comment, not a connected frame.
/api/tasks/events · GET /api/tasks/sidebar-state returns a JSON snapshot of the same sidebar state
Sent with X-Accel-Buffering: no so a reverse proxy does not buffer the stream.
/api/agent-executions/events · frames carry agentExecutionId, oldStatus and newStatus from AgentExecutionStatusChangedEvent
Opens with a bare connected frame and no snapshot; served by the same router as the task stream.
/api/workflows/runs/<id>/events · one workflow run: status, step, loop, map and approval events
The frame formats are owned by the Workflow Architecture document.
/api/events · the route lives in config_api_routes.dart and subscribes one client to SseBroadcast
Names: budget_warning, loop_detected, rate_limit_warning, emergency_stop, context_warning, compaction_starting, announce.
/api/sessions/<id>/stream · one turn's chat stream; transient, so clients refetch the snapshot on conversation_changed
An unknown turn answers 404 TURN_NOT_FOUND; a settled turn replays its terminal frames.
